The company states the fair-value calculation for its long-term debt will change from daily to monthly updates effective 10 November 2025 due to reduced market volatility; this does not affect the debt-at-par NAV. The NAV levels and the move to monthly debt fair-value updates may modestly reduce short-term reported NAV volatility and transparency for investors.
